notes.title: Race against time in Patch 25.28.0!
notes.content:
Race against time in Patch 25.28.0!


Hey everyone!

Over the past few months, I've been diving into all sorts of experiments, and the best ones are now part of this patch. There’s still a lot brewing behind the scenes, but as you know, magic potions take time.


Main changes
The main interface screens have been redesigned for a cleaner look, without giving up clarity and ease of use. In particular:

Pause menu;

Workshop level set menu;

Game mode selection menu;

Level selection menu.

Additional minor tweaks help unify the style across various sections.


But that’s not all...
It’s time to unveil a brand new game mode!


A new tale: Speedrun Mode
You can now compete in PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark! Challenge players from around the world, climb the timed leaderboards of the most demanding levels, and race against the clock - and more - to earn your glory!

In this mode, you'll take on a set of levels that includes both Story Mode and Escape levels!


Minor changes and fixes
Adjusted the character's hitbox to prevent unwanted sliding along the edges of blocks and platforms.

Fixed several inconsistencies in menu translations.

Squashed lots... and lots of bugs.

 
Available now!
All new features are already in the game: download or update PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark now and let me know what you think of the project’s evolution!

See you soon!

notes.title: Lots of new content in Patch 25.17.0!
notes.content:
Lots of new content in Patch 25.17.0!

Hello everyone!

In the month following the game's release, I've had time to reflect and experiment with new ideas that I'm finally ready to share with you.

Main changes

Revamped several interfaces: the game mode menu now features more appealing button designs; the Sandbox menu has been completely redesigned, with a new system for displaying level sets; some elements of the Sandbox interface have also been refined.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/2467508facdfaed1aa3bd4031e963058193301af.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/825e0430b4085443bd0beb5cd6dcebcd423cd7b5.png
Added sound effects for Temporary Blocks and Propulsor Blocks.
The button for Hardcore mode will no longer appear at the end of the Echo level, but only after completing the entire Story Mode.

But that’s not all...
It’s time to talk about the new additions!

New in-game additions
New blocks
Bulb: a block that can emit light... or darkness.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/a31f01ef80a42da9a95e802795dacff08853a5db.png
Block (key): can only be removed using a key.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/92a663e3b6e39355a4bd7f4a2e4c4eb05c064987.png
Key
Once you approach a key, it will start to follow you until it finds a Key Block to unlock.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/0c246626b39ad37d44191b83082b851e8d569625.png
Dead Singularity
The Dead Singularity is what remains of a collapsed Singularity: it expands endlessly, destroying everything in its path.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/3e89bf7db71600941e5a94ccb3fdb37553c84674.png
Hourglass
The Hourglass is born from the collision of two Prisms, which fused to generate an object capable of enabling passage between different dimensions of light... but only for a limited time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/5ad467740a252d16a2125ffe2225f58319e79d0b.png
A new tale
The new content arrives with two new game modes: Escape and Permadeath, two sides of the same nightmare.

In the first, you must escape from a crumbling realm determined to hold you back by any means. In the second, you’ll face an extreme challenge where every mistake has real and permanent consequences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/8ea7b34b70766d55811f4a1fdb748171f9c0d4f8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/df8810327bde5f287c305a38669d95c204e136f2.png
Minor changes and fixes

Changed the number of charges of an Orb in the Veritas level: from 3 to 5.
Slightly reduced block collision to minimize the “floating player” effect.
Also reduced the collisions of Singularities.
Fixed some translations that weren’t displaying correctly.
Propulsor Blocks now stop slightly farther from platforms, preventing the risk of getting stuck.
Fixed several bugs.
Changed the system for indicating game versions; from now on it will be year.week.version.

Available now!
All these features are already integrated into the game. Don’t waste time: download or update it, and let me know what you think about the evolution of PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark!

See you soon!

notes.title: PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark is now available on Steam!

PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark is now available on Steam!

Hello everyone!

I’m excited to announce that my game, PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark, is available on Steam starting today. After months of hard work, I’m thrilled to finally share this unique experience with you.

Support and Updates

Join the Community

notes.title: Release Date Announcement for PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark
notes.content:
Release Date Announcement for PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark

Hello everyone!

The moment has finally arrived: PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark will be available on Steam starting on March 21, 2025 at 18:00 CET!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/08102fa0d907b9b884c64cc098af4dcd62228b5f.png

The game has reached the point I envisioned it to be. I am extremely satisfied with the result and cannot wait to share it with all of you. However, this does not mean that the journey ends here: there will be improvements and new additions in the future, also based on your feedback.

All future updates and additional content will always be free for those who own the game. No paid extra content: I want every player to experience PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark in its entirety and as an ever-evolving adventure.

The most important news will be announced here on Steam, but if you want to discover extra content and insights into the development process, you can also follow me on the social channels listed below.

Thank you for your support: see you on March 21 as we explore together the darkness of this mysterious world!

See you soon!

notes.title: Big News Coming to PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark!
notes.content:
Big News Coming to PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark!

Hello everyone!

It's been a few months since the last update, and there's a good reason for that: I've been pouring all my energy into developing this game.

We're at a pivotal moment, and the incredible support received during last October's Steam Next Fest has motivated me more than ever. I can't thank you enough, players, for the trust you've placed in this project and the amazing connections we've built.

A Game Reimagined from Scratch!
Taking into account your invaluable feedback and some new ideas, the game has undergone significant changes and additions. Let’s dive into the updates together!

Main Changes
"Did you... did you say something?": NPCs and the player can now have conversations! This feature has allowed me to greatly expand on the game's original story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/74282787bd0c0166d0782477cf3f0f0d557d9857.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/5ec5f49e6dbeee62343ba842fa204d94993cce41.png
A New Way to Travel Between Levels: The door has been replaced with a mystical portal, better fitting the game's atmosphere.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/b9006199bdc3390d57efce037f2c6afa6c5edf9f.png
Updated Textures: Basic blocks, shards, and some icons have a new look, enhancing the overall aesthetic.
Input Improvements: Added controller and mouse/keyboard glyphs for a more intuitive gameplay experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/ca98720d17a24d47e2fce532151357dcfa7802c8.png
Revamped Interface: A redesigned UI makes it more visually appealing and user-friendly.
Level Optimization: The structure and level sets have been completely revamped to improve game performance and scalability.
Structural Changes: Technical refinements for a better gameplay experience.
And the Best is Yet to Come...
Let’s move on to the new implementations!

Game Additions
New Blocks
These new blocks join the existing ones, introducing new mechanics and puzzle types.
Jump Block: Changes its state from solid to non-solid depending on the player's jump.
Shard Block: Becomes solid by collecting hidden shards in the level set. This adds another layer of complexity to the game: a temporal one, complementing the spatial challenges.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/06d8855a888910d912d7f7e7427842072b289c54.png
Checkpoints
One of the most requested features! Checkpoints serve as respawn points in case of death and reset timers, giving players more time to complete levels. Shards collected are temporarily saved upon activation, but to fully claim them, you still need to complete the level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/6dcd8b70c376599345420fd2060d01a63bfe5556.png
New Power-Up: The Spring!
This new mechanic lets you jump mid-air, even repeatedly, depending on the charges provided by the power-up, allowing you to reach otherwise impossible distances.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/dd631d9f8b911308b7cf24d28f05fbaf962f44d9.png
New Areas!
The newly introduced areas come with unique mechanics to enrich the gameplay experience. They activate when the player enters or exits them. Here are the different types of areas:
Info: Displays a customizable panel with an image and text upon activation (in Sandbox mode). In Story mode, they're used for instructions on controls and navigating PHOTOBIA's dark world. [spoiler]And more.[/spoiler]
Timer: Sets a time limit to complete the current level, increasing challenge and tension.
Color: Changes the light dimension the player is in, creating dimensional pockets and making the environment more dynamic.
Light: Enables or disables the light emitted by the character.
These areas add depth and vibrancy to the game world, turning each level into an even more engaging puzzle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/2d95a5d76fe376eaf5879176fb68219e9f480326.png
A New Tale, an Improved Story Mode
The listed features are integrated into a completely renewed story mode, with updated levels designed to make the most of the new mechanics.

Available Now!
All these additions are already present in the demo, with save progress, including collected shards, carrying over to the full version of the game. So don’t wait: download or update the demo, and let me know your thoughts on how PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark is shaping up!

Thanks again for your incredible support.

See you soon!

notes.title: PHOTOBIA: Big news coming and participation in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
PHOTOBIA: Big news coming and participation in Steam Next Fest!

Hello everyone!

I’m thrilled to bring you the latest updates on PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark. Over the past months, I’ve been working tirelessly to improve every aspect of the game, and I can’t wait to share the results with you!

Optimizations and Improvements

Bug Fixes: I’ve spent a lot of time hunting down and eliminating a multitude of bugs. The game’s stability has significantly improved!
Level Restructuring: I’ve completely revamped how levels and level sets are structured. This has led to significant optimizations, both in terms of performance and space usage. Additionally, I’ve added more detail to the story levels and modified others to make them more intuitive, especially based on the feedback I gathered from letting more people test the game. A huge thanks to everyone who provided feedback!
Revamped Interfaces: The user interface has undergone a complete rework, both in the various menus and in sandbox mode. As for the latter, the experience is now more intuitive and enjoyable!

A Sneak Peek at the New Features

Here are some images showcasing the recent improvements:

The "before" of the sandbox interface. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/85b8d32d1fb7e2d289aafe53d04bb02ebb46749b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/70e7de6b3be63faaa781fe3f4be5778d951ec936.png

The "after" of the sandbox interface - more intuitive and pleasant to use. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/c2d657dac975e7cb45c6ec39510b382d52e0bf6e.png

The new mode menu - clean, sleek, and attractive. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/065c63d336e8e71026a394cfea80d740a9717d2b.png

PHOTOBIA at Steam Next Fest

As the last piece of news (but certainly not least!), I’m excited to announce that PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark will be featured at the Steam Next Fest from October 14 to 21!

During the event, you’ll be able to try out the demo, experience the latest improvements to the levels, and share your feedback, which is crucial in making the game even better!

Join the Community and Stay Updated!

Add PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark to your Steam wishlist to stay on top of the most important news! And if you want to be an active part of development, report bugs, propose new features, or simply chat with other fans, join our Discord server! You’ll find the link at the bottom of this article. Together, we can make PHOTOBIA even more extraordinary!

I can’t wait to see your reactions and hear your feedback. Your passion and support are what drive me to give my best every day.

Get ready to dive into the darkness of PHOTOBIA like never before.

See you soon!

notes.title: The PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark Demo is Finally Available!
notes.content:
The PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark Demo is Finally Available!

Hello everyone!

I’m excited to announce that the PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark demo is finally available for download! This is a special moment for me, and I really hope you’ll join me on this adventure.

What does the demo include?
 
 14 story levels 
 A taste of the puzzle system 
 About 30-60 minutes of gameplay 
 Progress transferable to the full game (saved only once the demo is completed, collected shards are not saved)

How to access the demo
[olist] 
 Visit the game’s page on Steam 
 Scroll down to “Download PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark Demo” 
 Click the “Download” button 
 Wait for the download and installation to finish 
 Jump into the adventure! 
[/olist]
I’m eagerly awaiting your feedback. Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts and suggestions here on Steam or report bugs in the relevant sections of our Discord server.

Thank you in advance for your support, it really means a lot!

Happy gaming and see you soon!

notes.title: Embrace the Fun: Controller Support in Development!
notes.content:
Controller Support: An Important Step in Development!

Hello everyone!

I’m excited to share an update on our development: I’m working on controller support! Soon, you’ll be able to dive into the game using your favorite controller, and I can’t wait for you to try it out.

Steam Controller
DualShock 4
Xbox One Controller

I’ve already started testing these options, and I’m really pleased with how they’re performing in Story and Hardcore modes. My goal is to make the game more accessible and enjoyable for those who prefer using a controller over mouse and keyboard.

That said, I want to be clear: creating levels in sandbox mode and navigating menus will continue to be available only with mouse and keyboard for the time being. I’ve focused first on what matters most: delivering an engaging gameplay experience in the main modes, and I believe we’re on the right track!

I’m really excited to hear what you think and can’t wait to share the next steps with you!

Stay tuned for more updates, and if you haven’t already, add PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark to your Steam wishlist to keep up with the latest news.

See you soon!

notes.title: PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark. A World of Puzzles and Adventures Awaits!
notes.content:
PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark. A World of Puzzles and Adventures Awaits!

Hello everyone!

I’m excited to announce that the development of PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark has reached a crucial point! After months of hard work and dedication, the heart of the game is ready, and I can’t wait to share with you all the progress made so far.

Current Development Status

With all the main modes and features completed, I am focusing on the final touches to enhance the overall experience. Even though the game is now complete, I’m working to refine every aspect and ensure the best possible experience.

What to Expect

Physics Challenges: Each level has been designed to let you experience physics in innovative ways. It will be an engaging journey that will challenge your mind and problem-solving skills.
Hardcore Mode: How would you feel if you were constantly watched by someone ready to catch up with you? The hardcore mode offers an intense and adrenaline-pumping experience that will test every move you make.
Sandbox and Workshop: Your creativity is key to the world of PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark. Create and share your puzzles with the community through the Steam Workshop. Every contribution enriches the world of PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark and offers new challenges for other players.

I’m curious to see how you’ll interact with this world I’ve created.

Stay tuned for more updates and, if you haven’t already, add PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark to your Steam wishlist so you don’t miss any news.

See you soon!
